Notice of Public Hearings – Revisions to the Fairfield County Subdivision Regulations
Public hearings November 3 and November 10, 2026 on proposed changes to the review process for lot access in minor subdivisions and exempt lot splits.
Public notice

Pickerington Implements Handle With Care Program into School System for the 26-27 School Year
A trauma-support program alerting school staff to help students without sharing details.
Press release
07.22.26
Auditor Highlights Popular Annual Financial Report
A concise, easy-to-read snapshot of Fairfield County governmental finances, using charts and plain language as a companion to the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report.
Press release
07.20.26
NASA Veteran and County Native Allison Bolinger Speaks at P.O.W.E.R. Event
Leadership, resilience, and professional growth for local women.
Press release
07.17.26
County Auditor Team Recognized for Commitment to Professional Development
Kami Neal, Amanda Hoskinson, and Arika Farrar completed the National Association of Counties (NACo) High Performance Leadership Academy, reflecting the team's ongoing commitment to professional growth and excellence in public service.
Press release
06.30.26
County Auditor Launches New Real Estate Property Search Website
A new online Real Estate Property Search website makes searching parcel information faster, easier, and more transparent for residents, owners, businesses, and real estate professionals.
Press release
06.29.26
County Honored with National Award for Strategic Planning and Fiscal Innovation
Fairfield County earns two 2026 NACo Achievement Awards recognizing its innovation, operational excellence, and effective public service.
Press release
06.17.26
Community Survey Seeks Input from County Older Adults
An anonymous mailed survey will help guide programs and services for aging residents.
Press release
06.05.26
County Awarded $1 Million Brownfield Remediation Grant
The Land Bank will transform the former Barclay Petroleum site in Bremen into community recreation space with fields, trails, and creek access.
Press release
